name: AdCP 3.2 Content-Type header sent as multiple field values (malformed — covered field must be single-valued, content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 1 (covered component fields must be single-valued; RFC 9421 §2.1 derivation rules do not permit concatenation for non-list headers); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/022-multi-valued-content-type.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The Signature is a valid Ed25519 signature over expected_signature_base, which carries the Content-Type value exactly as sent, so the multi-valued field is the only fault. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
